focus: Devin CLI + Cursor CLI boundaries and the normalized event/message model

label: devin acp is a first-class ACP server over stdio JSON-RPC, non-interactive
Devin --export provides ATIF conversation export after each turn
Cursor agent acp streams session/update with agent_message_chunk text
Cursor ACP flow: initialize, authenticate, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel, request_permission
Cursor ACP extension methods: ask_question, create_plan (blocking); update_todos, task, generate_image (notifications)
Cursor CLI hooks are editor hooks; envelope permission/user_message/agent_message only, not renderer
Cursor CLI does not deliver beforeSubmitPrompt under tested build
ACP is a shared client adapter family across Devin, Cursor, OpenCode
Six-CLI taxonomy: native-replacement (Claude MessageDisplay, Pi message_end/renderers) vs pipeline-owner (Codex, OpenCode, Devin, Cursor)
Normalized envelope: {runtime, sessionId, messageId, eventType, index, final, delta, parts, sequence}
Canonical-state preservation: normalized model is projection input, never write-back; only display-only channels mutate
